summary: Frontend-only smoke + Dashboard functional test on the public preview URL with an allowlisted session cookie for agenciakrai@gmail.com. Verified: (1) Dashboard header stats (Reportajes/Fotografías/Procesadas/Completados) render for the 2 demo projects; (2) 'project-search-input' filters correctly ('Marta' -> 1 card); (3) 'project-sort-select' sorts by name (A-Z result: 'Boda Ana & Luis', 'Boda Marta & Juan'); (4) each project card shows client_name and formatted event_date ('Ana & Luis', '10 may 2026'); (5) edit-project-<id> opens modal in edit mode with prefilled name/client/date; PUT /api/projects/{id} succeeds and card re-renders with the new name; edit reverted successfully; (6) all 7 nav buttons (nav-dashboard/autobasic/styles/learning/engine/validation/profiles) navigate to the correct route and each target page renders its key testid (autobasic-empty, style-name-input/style-url-input, learning-upload-btn, lab-full-toggle + lab-pick-folder-btn, validation-empty, extract-url-input + extract-analyze-btn). catalog-search-input/catalog-group-toggle are correctly absent because the profile catalog is empty (only appear when >0 profiles). 0 console errors, 0 pageerror events across the whole run.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx delete handler (remove) has no try/catch — a failing DELETE will leave the card removed from state optimistically without user feedback and no rollback. Wrap in try/catch and toast.error + restore on failure.

Dashboard sort by 'event' uses localeCompare on ISO date strings (b.event_date - a.event_date). Works while dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD' but silently mis-sorts if event_date is ever null/empty (empty string sorts last which is fine, but mixed formats would break). Consider explicit Date-based comparator with null-last guard.
openEdit uses e.stopPropagation() but relies on the caller passing the event; safer to also call e?.preventDefault(). Minor.
